summary: OR Royalties Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a rock mass movement at the Barnat open pit at the Canadian Malartic Complex, operated by Agnico Eagle Mines Limited. The filing is an operational update regarding a mine wall movement that temporarily suspended mining operations and may reduce gold production. No special-situation transaction is announced; the registrant is merely providing disclosure of an operational event that may affect its royalty revenue. The report does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant's 2026 guidance remains unchanged. As a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
